Restored the check; the targeted test passed and git diff was empty. The mutant failure diagnostic included the test response, so no response content is retained in this receipt or report.

Inspected crates/holden-mcp/tests/mcp.rs and reopened the integration tests in both gates: the tests use an rmcp client over a real Unix socket and launch the server as a child over real stdio; no mock replaces the MCP server, transport, or peer credentials. Revalidated the receipt successfully against its original candidate cc677f6 after copying the freeze, reopen attestation, and QA pin records from 0023b36 into that scratch checkout.

Computed attempt-1 receipt SHA-256 9d3564ffb573478c54a0b6f61966e4cc765ffe6ea42c4fe58feae308e961da4a.
